radare2 on ReactOS

loading...
Open cmd from the Start menu and type r2 C:\ReactOS\system32\cmd.exe — radare2 lives in C:\radare2. Disk data is streamed on demand; the first boot downloads a few tens of MB. On phones: drag on the screen to move the mouse, tap to click, long-press to right-click, and use the Keyboard button to type. Upload or drop files to mount them in the ReactOS CD drive (normally D:).
